q: It's important to keep the symbol alive above all else.
w: Re-ruled at B4a-06: four placed themes reach three concepts, so the item was a bag under the bag test as it stood, and the B4a-05 ruling cut my B1's T3-022 by the limit (a slip; J's QB4-003 answer adds no theme here). Both readers placed T3-021 and T3-005. 'Could use some help here..!', 'Help defend our sign', 'We need help defending!', 'Defend it first, it's getting destroyed' and 'we managed to *completely* defend' call to and report the defence (T3-005, both readers), seven concepts, the largest act; it is the bag's placed theme. 'This Yuti guy is messing up our original location so I think we should find another place', 'We'd be better off starting elsewhere', 'the most important part is getting back on the map' and the 'new (and hopefully final) LOLICON' restart the work after the loss (T3-022, my B1), four. 'It's been destroyed, but we can recover.', clearing the dark tiles and 'still working to keep this banner alive' repair (T3-021, all three placements), three. 'Expansion needs to wait until we have less than 20 or so errors', 'It's important to keep the symbol alive above all else' and 'focus on keeping our small loli sign together' choose upkeep over growth (T3-042, my B1), three. Four themes reach three concepts, so the item is a bag.
